The '''1955 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship''' was the 69th staging of the All-Ireland [[hurling]] championship since its establishment by the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]] in 1887. The championship began on 24 April 1955 and ended on 4 September 1955.

[[Cork GAA|Cork]] were the [[1954 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|defending champions]], however, they were defeated in the provincial series. [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] won the title following a 3–13 to 2–8 defeat of [[Galway GAA|Galway]] in the [[1955 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|final]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.askaboutireland.ie/reading-room/sports-recreation/sport/wexford-hurling/wexford-hurling-in-the-19/all-ireland-win-1955/|title=All-Ireland win 1955|publisher=Ask About Ireland website|access-date=16 October 2013}}</ref>

==Teams==

A total of fourteen teams contested the championship, the same as the [[1953 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|previous championship]], however, there were some changes on personnel. [[Antrim GAA|Antrim]] withdrew from the senior championship, while [[Wicklow GAA|Wicklow]] fielded a team in the [[Leinster Senior Hurling Championship]].

===Miscellaneous===
* The attendance of 23,125 is one of the lowest attendances at a Munster final in recent years.
* The attendance of 50,840 at the game between [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] and [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] was a new record for an All-Ireland semi-final.
* Wexford win their second All-Ireland title, their first since [[1910 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|1910]].
